mapper.insert: INSERT INTO artifact (tenant_id, workitem_id, dispatch_id, name, type, oss_ref, size, meta_json) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workitemId}, #{dispatchId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{ossRef}, #{size}, #{metaJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), workitem_id = VALUES(workitem_id), type = VALUES(type), oss_ref = VALUES(oss_ref), size = VALUES(size), meta_json = VALUES(meta_json)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM artifact WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM artifact WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
